subject: Co-sell swarm demo — tri-region rehearsal & marketplace cutover windows
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya@cloudmariners.io>
To: rishi@redwood.com
Cc: partners@cloudmariners.io
Date: 2028-03-21T08:15:00+01:00
Subject: Intro + three-region co-sell rehearsal windows

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the intro at the partner call last week. CloudMariners is lined up with Acme (end customer) and we want to run a coordinated marketplace demo that covers: hosted API call flow, Dedicated capacity failover, and Private deployment security brief. The ask from Acme is a short, focused ‘swarm’ rehearsal to validate roles + fallbacks across regions before the marketplace listing goes live.

High-level asks: 
- 45-minute run-through + 30-minute triage
- One technical lead from Redwood per region (us/eu/apac)
- Marketplace listing checklist sign-off during the run

Attached is a one-page agenda and a spreadsheet of proposed windows. Can you confirm availability for next week? We have a soft preference for a morning CET slot to accommodate Acme in London and CloudMariners in Bangalore (follow-the-sun facilitator).

Attachments: [co-sell-agenda-v2.pdf (230KB)], [proposed-timeslots.xlsx (14KB)]

Thanks,
Priya
Director, Partnerships — CloudMariners
[partners@cloudmariners.io]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya@cloudmariners.io>
Cc: vanessa@redwood.com, karthik@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-21T11:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Intro + three-region co-sell rehearsal windows

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the agenda and the clear asks. This is something we can support but a couple of constraints up front:
1) Marcus (our Marketplace PM) will need the final runbook 72 hours before the rehearsal for the publishing checklist.
2) We need a low-latency EU host for the live portion; if Acme insists on a London presence we can use our dedicated pool in eu-west-2.
3) For the follow-the-sun facilitator role, Vanessa is the best fit; looping her on this thread.

Propose the following concrete plan:
- Run A (primary): 2028-03-28 09:30-10:45 CET (live demo + triage)
- Run B (fallback rehearsal): 2028-03-29 14:00-15:15 CET (APAC-led dry run)
- Cutover blackout window for marketplace listing: 2028-04-02 06:00-10:00 CET (we'll need capacity pinning)

If those windows look OK I’ll ask Marcus to confirm the pre-flight checklist items and he can add the doc to the Drive link.

Rishi
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[rishi@redwood.com]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya@cloudmariners.io>, rishi@redwood.com
Cc: karthik@redwood.com, marcus@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-22T09:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Intro + three-region co-sell rehearsal windows

Thanks — looping in a couple scheduling constraints from the SI side: 
- Karthik please note: our SI partner (regional tech ops) cannot do any maintenance windows on 2028-03-29 between 13:00-16:00 CET — that conflicts with their sprint cutover.
- To accommodate Bangalore, we should avoid starting earlier than 08:30 CET and no later than 10:00 CET for the primary run.

Alternate schedule that works for everyone I checked with ops:
- Primary run: 2028-03-28 09:00-10:15 CET (prefers this — keeps Acme in morning and gives APAC overlap)
- Dry run: 2028-03-30 14:30-15:45 CET (APAC lead)
- Marketplace blackout: 2028-04-02 07:00-11:00 CET (shifted +1 hour to respect ops)

I’ve attached a slimmed timeslot grid — please update the spreadsheet with names and I’ll lock calendar invites once Marcus tickboxes the runbook.

Attachment stub: [proposed-timeslots.xlsx (14KB)]

—Vanessa
Senior Partner Ops — Redwood Inference

- Attendee list: Priya (CloudMariners), Saurabh Rao (tech lead, BLR), Tom Baker (Acme - product), Hannah Lee (Acme - security).
- Can Redwood own the failure-mode demo at T+25 minutes (simulate Dedicated pool eviction and fallback to hosted variant)? Acme specifically wants to see graceful degradation.
- We added a short block in the agenda to validate logging/audit trail retention for Private deployment (Hannah to confirm retention requirements).

I uploaded an annotated agenda with attendee initials and a sample failure script — link and attachments below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0AExAMPLE/co-sell-agenda-annotated

If Redwood can take the failure-mode demo and Marcus can confirm the runbook by Friday (2028-03-25 EOD) we’ll lock invites.

Best,
Priya
